two behavioral quantification methods, computerized videotracked activity and manually recorded posture events, are suitable to measure zebrafish behavioral responses to novelty, predator models, and social stimuli.

automated video analysis of zebrafish behavior is reliable and can be used for high throughput screening, but that further development of automated analysis of posture and behavior patterns may be needed.
automated videotracked quantification of zebrafish behavior is reliable, but that further refinement of posture pattern recognition may improve the method.

the development of behavioral tests for the zebrafish and the establishment of a behavioral phenotyping platform for high throughput screening of brain function.
developing behavioral tests and quantification methods to facilitate the use of the zebrafish as a model for studying brain function.
the development and evaluation of behavioral tests and quantification methods that will allow the zebrafish to be used for high throughput behavioral phenotyping.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
all three quantification methods are useful, but that videotracking has the advantage of being automatable and therefore suitable for high throughput screening.
all three quantification methods have their strengths and weaknesses.
automated videotracked activity parameters are a reliable and valid measure of zebrafish behavior, but further refinement may be needed to increase sensitivity to posture changes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the automated videotracking method is the best choice for the quantification of zebrafish behavioral phenotypes.
zebrafish are suitable for behavioral studies, and that computerized videotracked behavior is a promising tool for high throughput screening.

the zebrafish is an excellent model for behavioral research, and that the combination of computerized videotracked activity measures with event recording of behavior patterns will provide the most comprehensive analysis of zebrafish behavior.

automated behavioral quantification is a powerful tool for high throughput behavioral analysis of zebrafish.
